name: Defies Death's Embrace
description: You are cursed with immortality, having lived through centuries and accumulated both knowledge and regrets.
connectionOptions: One PC reminds you of a lost love from centuries past.
You once knew one PC's ancestor and see the family resemblance.
One PC is researching historical events you personally witnessed.
You believe one PC might hold the key to ending your immortality.
additionalEquipment: Antique pocket watch that never stops
Vial of your own blood (which has unusual properties)

abilities.name: Undying
abilities.description: You cannot die from old age or disease. When you would die from damage, you instead fall unconscious and awaken fully healed after 1d6 hours.

abilities.name: Historical Insight
abilities.description: You're trained in history and can provide firsthand accounts of past events.

abilities.name: Blood Magic
abilities.description: You can use your blood to perform minor magical effects, such as healing minor wounds or creating small illusions.

abilities.name: Centuries of Experience
abilities.description: Once per day, you can draw upon your vast experience to become trained in a skill of your choice for one hour.

abilities.name: Drain Life
abilities.description: You can drain life force from a willing or helpless creature, healing yourself but potentially harming them.

abilities.name: Phantom Form
abilities.description: You can temporarily transform into a mist-like form, becoming intangible and able to pass through solid objects.

abilities.name: Defy Fate
abilities.description: Once per session, you can completely negate a single attack or harmful effect targeting you or an ally within short range.
